draft_en.subject: Industrial switch price list from ISAF - for the Hanwha camera projects
draft_en.body:
Hi Serdar,

We met at ISAF 2025 in Istanbul last October - this picks up what we discussed at the booth.

The industrial switch prices you asked for, all DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS, MOQ 1, 15-day validity:

- Unmanaged, model STI-288GP - $59.8 USD EXW
- L2 managed, model STI-288GPM - $82.2 USD EXW
- L2+ managed with ring redundancy, model STI-288DGGPM - $137.5 USD EXW

For the head end of a 150-camera deployment like Pamukkale, the 24 x PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP L2+ rack unit STC-424DGGPM-280W is $140.1.

One question: do your Hanwha projects use a ring topology in the field - in which case I would recommend the ring-capable model?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
